# devin_oncall_schemas (Data Source)

Describes what devin_oncall_responder accepts for an organization: the trigger event types and condition fields per alert source, the connected sources, the PagerDuty connection to use, and the defaults applied when runbook or session_settings are omitted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "devin_oncall_schemas" "this" {
  org_id = devin_organization.payments.org_id
}

# Trigger event types available to the organization, e.g.
# ["pagerduty:incident_triggered", ..., "slack:message", "slack:usergroup_mentioned"].
output "oncall_event_types" {
  value = sort(flatten([for source in values(jsondecode(data.devin_oncall_schemas.this.sources)) : keys(source)]))
}

# A PagerDuty responder takes the account's PagerDuty connection from here.
resource "devin_oncall_responder" "pd_payments" {
  org_id                  = devin_organization.payments.org_id
  name                    = "Payments P1 (PagerDuty)"
  pagerduty_connection_id = data.devin_oncall_schemas.this.pagerduty_connection_id
  triggers                = jsonencode([{ event_type = "pagerduty:incident_triggered" }])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) Organization ID.

### Read-Only

- `available_devin_modes` (List of String) Every session_settings.devin_mode the organization may set on responders.
- `default_devin_mode` (String) Mode applied when session_settings.devin_mode is omitted; null when sessions inherit the organization default.
- `default_net_policy` (String) JSON-encoded network policy applied when session_settings.net_policy is omitted; null when the governing security profile sets one.
- `default_runbook` (String) Runbook applied when a responder's runbook is blank.
- `jira_connected` (Boolean) Whether Jira responders are available: the organization has a Jira connection and the feature is enabled.
- `linear_connected` (Boolean) Whether Linear responders are available: the organization has a Linear connection and the feature is enabled.
- `pagerduty_connection_id` (String) PagerDuty connection to pass as devin_oncall_responder.pagerduty_connection_id; null when PagerDuty is not connected or not enabled.
- `pylon_connected` (Boolean) Whether Pylon responders are available: the organization has a Pylon connection with automation triggers turned on and the feature is enabled.
- `security_profile` (String) JSON-encoded security profile governing responder sessions; null when none applies.
- `slack_connected` (Boolean) Whether the organization has a Slack connection.
- `sources` (String) JSON-encoded map of source (slack, teams, pagerduty, webhook) -> event type -> schema ({event_type, name, category, fields}); use jsondecode(...). Only available sources are listed.
- `teams_connected` (Boolean) Whether Microsoft Teams responders are available.
- `webhook_responders_enabled` (Boolean) Whether webhook responders are available.
